title: NFL Media Partners Shatter Sales Record With $6 Billion Ad Haul

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: NFL Media Partners Shatter Sales Record With $6 Billion Ad Haul
sources.description: It should probably go without saying that there is rarely any downside to booking nearly $6 billion in advertising revenue, especially when that 10-figure windfall is 7% greater than the year-ago haul. As primetime unit costs continue to shrink alongside an ever-dwindling audience, the NFL’s media partners are practically swimming in marketing bucks—a dynamic that …
